summary: Aerolink's Starter plan is a free 1-week trial of its unified API gateway (Claude, OpenAI and other model routes) with a rolling allowance of $5 per 5 hours and $35 per week. No payment is required.
claim_steps: Generate an API key from the dashboard and point your client at the Aerolink base URL.
Starter trial runs 1 week with $5 per 5-hour window and $35 per week included.
